name: Ninja Training Room
desc1: A well toned man is here, dressed in padded black garb. He is circling
desc2: a cloth dummy hung from the ceiling. At your entry, he lunges
desc3: suddenly, running the dummy through with his long sword. Abruptly, he
desc4: seems to take notice of your presence, turns toward you, and casually
desc5: gestures with his blade to a couple of chairs set up against the wall.
desc6: He then continues his practice. A strange scent emits from a behind
desc7: a hole in the ceiling, covered by a curtain, above you.
